gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4 Max, Unspecified Version)
method: Actual MoonFall catalog; repeated 2/10/2/40/2/100/2/200/60 km views with nadir and 1.45 rad tilt. Same native inventory, physical terrain and 8x filtering for history comparisons. Old code at 160MiB, repaired state machine at 160MiB, and final mission target at 512MiB are reported separately. Final acceptance waits 30 consecutive fully idle frames before sampling and then measures 60 stationary frames per view.
cause: Committed split flags survived eviction, so returning branches silently reused L1/L3 without requesting their evicted pages. Recovery now reconciles residency, queues coherent frontiers, retains usable prior detail and parents, and publishes completed intermediate fallback waves before proceeding deeper.

gpuCoverComparison.note: CPU rays use the actual GL pixel centre; historical diagnostic runs sampled integer NDC boundaries and their GPU mismatch counts are not compared.

filtering.policy: 8x request, clamped by Three to device support, configured before array allocation
filtering.note: Same page IDs and residency before/after; anisotropy does not repair eviction-state blocks.

limits: Historical and same-budget diagnostic runs could stop at a transient budget-limited boundary; final acceptance requires fully quiescent native recovery.
Request/eviction totals have different cache targets and quiet-frame protocols; no direct throughput claim is made.
The final MoonFall target is 512MiB plus reported four-page transition headroom; physical terrain caching remains separate.
Sampling covers these recorded poses/device; it is not proof for every camera or GPU.
